title: Land of Never #5
desc: It’s a revolt in wonderland! But the Floating Man still sees himself as the big brother... and sometimes, that means discipline. For all its fury, Wendy’s rebellion is met with an even more brutal response from the Floating Man. After the first of the lost are smashed, the revolt gets starkly real... Suddenly, this isn’t childhood. There are deadly consequences. Jim Hoke and Casey Smith have never had a harder time getting along, the only thing that saves their partnership is a breakthrough. They find the Floating Man’s wonderland! But as they raid the surreal prison, they’re attacked by their own children…are the fathers too late?
